generationInput: each input binds canonical key/path/text SHA-256
batch input item count is explicit
batch input SHA-256 digest is recomputed before synthesis
full or story scope must match the approved generation-set evidence
provider: local generation uses an approved pinned provider profile
provider profile binds exact model/config/voice fingerprints and runtime commits
provider profile bytes are SHA-256 bound into the generation receipt
reference-speaker audio and voice cloning are forbidden by the approved Kokoro profile
receipt: inputDigestSha256 exactly matches the receipt key/path/text-hash input set
Kokoro receipt binds the exact approved provider profile path/id/SHA-256
rightsVerified: receipt generation input count/digest matches narration state
receipt item key/path/text/audio hashes match the canonical release asset
receipt provider/voice/language/generator metadata matches narration state
provider profile bytes and approval status still match the receipt/state binding
allowed rights claim with durable evidence references
sourceLineage: current generated narration receives generation-receipt technical lineage
receipt-backed source lineage is independent from rights provenance

generationPolicy: The generator may install audio plus a contemporaneous receipt, but it must not write content/narration-state.json. State changes occur only through the explicit receipt importer.
legacyPolicy: Existing narration without contemporaneous generation receipts remains unverified. Do not create retrospective receipts merely to raise release coverage.
driftPolicy: Generation input, text, audio, receipt, provider profile, model/runtime identity, rights claim, or rights evidence drift revokes the relevant generated narration verification until a new valid receipt is imported.
importMode: dry-run by default; explicit --write required to mutate content/narration-state.json
